target_evidence: Research/Submission.lean:49-74 proves Research.BinaryTreeReduction.dotProductBackwardError for all model : Model and tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ), under only ((tree.depth + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * model.u < 1. It constructs perturbed with IsPerturbation (gamma (tree.depth + 1) model.u) (exactProductTree tree) perturbed and perturbed.exactSum = roundedDotProduct model tree. The conclusion is relative to exact componentwise products, not already-rounded products.

requirements.requirement: Prove the full universally quantified dot-product backward-error theorem.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:49-74 proves dotProductBackwardError for arbitrary model : Model and tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ), assuming only ((tree.depth + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * model.u < 1; its conclusion supplies a same-shape perturbation of exactProductTree whose exact sum equals roundedDotProduct.

requirements.requirement: Relate perturbations to exact componentwise products x_i*y_i.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:14-15 defines exactProductTree by mapping pair.1 * pair.2. Lines 53-54 state the final perturbation relative to this exact tree. Research/Projects/BinaryTreeReduction/Reduction.lean:17-23 enforces the same shape and |perturbed_i - exact_i| ≤ bound * |exact_i| at every leaf, including zero products.

requirements.requirement: Account for one rounded multiplication per leaf.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:10-11,18-24 computes one model.mul at every leaf before roundedSum; Research/Common/FloatingPoint/Model.lean:25-27 defines mul as round (a*b). Submission.lean:28-44 applies round_spec to each exact product and proves a model.u relative perturbation.

requirements.requirement: Account for every rounded tree addition in the reduction.
requirements.evidence: Research/Projects/BinaryTreeReduction/Reduction.lean:11-13 rounds addition at every internal node. Lines 112-171 prove the gamma k model.u reduction bound by depth induction, using round_spec at each node (150-151), scaling both subtrees (152-165), and preserving exact sum equality (166-171). Submission.lean:59-61 applies this theorem at tree.depth; Tree.lean:43-47 proves mapping preserves depth.

requirements.requirement: Establish the gamma(depth+1,u) componentwise perturbation bound.
requirements.evidence: Research/Common/FloatingPoint/Gamma.lean:8-9 defines gamma k u = k*u/(1-k*u), and lines 33-54 prove its one-error step. Research/Submission.lean:63-74 composes the multiplication bound u with the addition bound gamma depth u to obtain u + gamma depth u * (1+u), then bounds this by gamma (depth+1) u. Reduction.lean:41-71 proves the componentwise composition inequality.

requirements.requirement: Use only the stated model and smallness assumptions without assuming or restricting the conclusion.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:49-55 quantifies over every Model and every pair tree, with only the requested smallness hypothesis. Research/Common/FloatingPoint/Model.lean:15-19 requires nonnegative u and the relative rounding specification, with no exact-arithmetic or conclusion assumption. Submission.lean:56-58 derives the weaker depth smallness condition.
